info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Trading Models API
info.description: The Update Trading Models API enables financial institutions to modify existing trading models in the wholesale trading environment. This function is critical for adapting to market changes or enhancing model efficiency, thereby supporting dynamic trading strategies. Users can update parameters of specific trading models identified by unique identifiers. The API is particularly useful for traders, risk managers, and quantitative analysts who rely on precise model configurations to optimize their trading operations.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific trading model identified by RES-100045 in the wholesale trading system. You can modify various attributes of the trading model as needed.
